messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I ordered some things for my daughter recently, but she hasn't received them yet. Could you help me check which address the order was sent to, the tracking number, and if it's still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered. And if possible, I'd like to set my daughter's address as my default for future orders, so I don't have to keep changing it.

Sure—I can help with all of that, but first I need to authenticate you.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address** (best), or  
2) Your **first name + last name + ZIP code**

After that, please also send:
- The **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`) so I can check the **shipping address**, **tracking number**, and whether it’s **still in transit**.
- For the tablet: the **tablet product name** or **product/item ID** from your order (whatever you have), so I can confirm the **storage size**.
- The **address details** you want to set as default for your daughter (or tell me it’s already the same as the order’s shipping address, and I’ll confirm it once I pull the order).

I actually don't remember my email address right now, but my name is Lucas Santos and my ZIP code is 80239.

I don't have the order ID handy at the moment—could you maybe look it up with my name and ZIP code? I ordered just a few days ago for delivery to my daughter in Chicago. The tablet was part of that order, but I can't recall the exact model either. Sorry, my memory isn't what it used to be.

As for the address, I want to set my daughter's Chicago address as my default. Once you find the order, you should see her address there.

Thanks for helping me out. I don't get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.
